en: A vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a mountain landscape with a building (likely a hotel or inn) nestled at the foot of a rocky cliff. There are handwritten messages in Italian on the top and right borders of the postcard. The bottom caption in red identifies the location as 'Lavarone' and the building as 'Albergo alla stanga colla Filadonna.' Italian printed text runs vertically along the left edge. There is a handwritten date: 11-9-02.
